this paper expedites a novel idea of implementing a Model-Based Approach to assess and manage the risks faced by RVSAT-1, a student nano-satellite project, using SysML

The proposed model is constructed in a layered configuration in SysML, a general-purpose modelling language. The layers are organised in a top-down fashion allowing one to navigate from the top most system level to lower level elements.
This structure allows for seamless traceability and ease of access when performing validation and verification activities.
Risk Precedence Index for this proposal is defined as the product of the severity index number and the likelihood index number.
